text.en:
. The Securities and Exchange Commission Is hereby placed under the
administrative supervision of the Department of Trade and Industry.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done In the City of Manila, this M day of MAY
Thousand and Nine.
in the year of Our Lord, Two
ay the Fresident:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
